scope.source_authority: DeThiPDF PDFs and original PNGs; DeThiOCR is absent and was not used

method.visual_review: All 21 rendered pages and all 9 referenced published image assets were opened with view_image before findings were recorded.
method.pdf_page_numbering: Physical PDF pages, 1-based, not question order.
method.png_provenance: Each PDF embedded image's decoded RGB pixels matched its original PNG after alpha removal (SHA-256 of decoded RGB pixel bytes).
method.ocr_role: RapidOCR used only to locate header coordinates after visual review, never as source truth.
method.normalization: Whitespace, terminal punctuation, quote style, hyphens, Vietnamese i/y spelling and equivalent typographic sub/superscripts are not treated as substantive mismatches. Original question labels and A-D ordering are preserved.
method.not_an_answer_key_audit: False answer options are not source defects merely because they are mathematically false. No source mathematics or stored key is automatically repaired.

crop_coordinates.coordinate_space: original PNG decoded pixels, origin top-left
crop_coordinates.question_boxes: Conservative horizontal bands bounded by visually checked headers (RapidOCR locations only) or scan edges. Parent pages were visually viewed; not a claim of glyph-tight segmentation or separately viewing every band.
crop_coordinates.formula_boxes: All 9 formula-only crop regions were rendered with PyMuPDF from the PDF and separately opened with view_image.
crop_coordinates.source_png_vs_pdf: PNG size / PDF page size is 4/3 on each axis for all 21 pages. To render a native-pixel bbox with PyMuPDF, divide coordinates by 4/3 to obtain PDF points and render with Matrix(4/3,4/3).

method.additional_computation_scope: At the main task's request, 46 numeric candidate sets were computed from visually verified source values without consulting stored keys. These are separate from the completed 80-question source fidelity checks. A full theoretical answer-key audit was not requested here.
method.numeric_comparison_values: comparison_values_by_original_label may be a derived comparator (for example GCD or multiplicative order) rather than a literal option transcription; the proof states how it is obtained.
